main.description: Register a self-contained supply-chain VISUALIZATION artifact (browser-native: the in-browser kotoba-wasm node queries the Datom log and renders client-side, no server round-trip — ADR-2606013600). The viz payload + HTML are anchored as kotoba CID blocks. A redundancy/accountability surface, never a target-list (kabuto G2).

payloadCid.description: KotobaCid of the framed viz JSON payload (consumed by the kotoba-wasm node / kami-engine)

htmlCid.description: optional KotobaCid of the self-contained .htm viewer (data inlined, no external fetch)
